metadata.title: Generalized quadratic matrix manifolds: Riemannian geometry and computations
metadata.abstract: We study the set $\mathrm{Gq}(P,Q)$ of real $n\times p$ matrices $X$ satisfying $X^\top Q X = P$, where the nonsingular matrices $P$ and $Q$ are both symmetric or both skew-symmetric and the set is nonempty. Special choices of $P$ and $Q$ yield the Stiefel, generalized Stiefel, indefinite Stiefel, and symplectic Stiefel manifolds, as well as the quadratic matrix Lie groups. We prove that $\mathrm{Gq}(P,Q)$ is a closed embedded submanifold of $\mathbb{R}^{n \times p}$ and that it is compact exactly when $P$ and $Q$ are both symmetric and definite of the same sign. We derive closed-form expressions for its tangent space and, under a canonical-like Riemannian metric, for the normal space, the orthogonal projection, and the Riemannian gradient and Hessian. We extend the Cayley, quasi-geodesic, and polar retractions to $\mathrm{Gq}(P,Q)$, with explicit domains, vector transports, and closed-form second-order corrections. These objects are the ingredients of Riemannian first- and second-order methods. In trace minimization tests with symmetric positive-definite, skew-symmetric, and symmetric indefinite pairs $(P,Q)$, the Riemannian conjugate gradient and trust-region methods reach the same objective value with different retractions and keep the iterates on $\mathrm{Gq}(P,Q)$ up to rounding error.

analysis.progressType: 矩阵约束流形的统一几何
analysis.workSummary: 统一研究 XᵀQX=P 定义的非空矩阵集合，证明嵌入子流形与紧性判据，并计算典范型度量下的投影、梯度、Hessian、回缩及向量传输。
analysis.breakthrough: 把多种 Stiefel 流形和二次矩阵群放入统一可实现框架。
analysis.limitations: P、Q 均非奇异且同属对称或反对称；数值测试的成功不等于所有算法的全局收敛保证。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。关键词命中位于参考文献的 AAAI 会议名称，不是本文使用生成式 AI 的披露；全文检索未见正面协作声明。

analysis.priorityReason: 适合矩阵流形算法使用者，理论对象与计算接口明确。
